description: This is a Java test class for testing REST API endpoints related to client resources, using Spring Boot testing framework and RestAssured library.

classes.name: ClientResourceTest
classes.description: Test class for client resource REST API endpoints, including creating a client and retrieving client details.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes RestAssured port before each test.

methods.name: should_return_created_user
